title: Goodell Contract Extended After $270B Team Value Gain Since 2006

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Goodell Contract Extended After $270B Team Value Gain Since 2006
sources.description: Roger Goodell reached an agreement on a four-year contract extension, the league announced Sunday. The deal runs through March 2031 and would mark 25 seasons with Goodell in charge, if he completes the contract.
